title: test(example-todo): boot the overdue-escalation kernel once per file under a measured budget
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiWpz18m9kVbxeipdp31C27T)_

Fixes #31311

Clause-②: no — test-only; no accept set, schema or export changes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`examples/app-todo/test/overdue-escalation-days-overdue.test.ts` 改成与 #31312 相同的形状。整个文件只在 `beforeAll` 里启动一次 kernel(带 30 秒实测预算),每条用例开始前经 driver 清空 `todo_task` 行。三条用例的断言一字未改,只改这一个测试文件。
- 为什么改:原来两条异步用例各自启动一个完整的 kernel。在负载高的 Test Core 分片上,第一条用例在 5016 ms 处被 vitest 默认的 5 秒截断(job 128575054246),把 #31220 踢出了合并队列。同一分片上,下一条用例也跑了 3822 ms。
- 风险与回滚:只改测试文件,不发布(skip-changeset)。隔离已验证:4 种乱序和每条单跑都绿。去掉清空这一步后,第三条先跑的顺序会变红。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:文件里的 `BOOT_BUDGET_MS` 和它上方的实测注释。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo exec vitest run test/overdue-escalation-days-overdue.test.ts`,预期 3/3 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `examples/app-todo/test/overdue-escalation-days-overdue.test.ts` only, in the shape #31312 gave `loop-body-iteration.test.ts`.
  - `bootTodoData()` runs once per file in `beforeAll`, under an explicit 30 000 ms budget (`BOOT_BUDGET_MS`). The measurement is written beside it. Before this change it ran inside each of the two async cases, under vitest's 5 s per-test default.
  - `beforeEach` deletes every `todo_task` row through the driver, so no hook observes the reset. Each case starts from the table a fresh boot leaves.
  - `afterAll` disconnects the one driver. This replaces the per-case `afterEach` driver list.
  - The file registers no fixture (no flow and no object beyond the boot), so there is nothing to clean up in a `finally`.
  - Every assertion is unchanged.

## Why

Queue job 128575054246, which ejected #31220:

| case | time |
|---|---|
| the `get_record` step declares no projection (sync, no boot) | 2 ms |
| every `{{ currentTask.… }}` hole … (boot + insert + find) | 5016 ms, `Test timed out in 5000ms` at `:129` |
| 0 when the task is not overdue … (boot + 2 inserts + find) | 3822 ms |

In the same job, `loop-body-iteration.test.ts`'s ESCALATION (fixed by #31312) also timed out, at 5024 ms. The package `Duration` was 68.24 s, with `import 149.87s`. The slowest sibling case was 2099 ms.

Locally, on 4 cores, I timed the boot phases inside the cases on the old file:

- Cold boot: `kernel.use` 3 ms, `bootstrap` 20–23 ms, sqlite-wasm `connect` 40–139 ms, `syncSchemas` 45–52 ms, Default Organization 36–54 ms.
- Warm second boot: `bootstrap` 4–5 ms, `connect` 1 ms, `syncSchemas` 18–20 ms, Default Organization 20–25 ms.
- The case that paid the cold boot took 192–279 ms in total, so nearly all of its wall was the boot.

## Tests

Case times in ms (sync, async 1, async 2), whole example suite, JSON reporter. "Load" means 8 CPU-bound processes running beside the suite.

| | idle | load |
|---|---|---|
| before (cold) | 2, 223, 68 | |
| before (warm) | 2, 199, 76 / 2, 205, 81 | 2, 466, 212 / 2, 693, 236 |
| after | 2, 45, 10 / 2, 32, 8 | 2, 36, 11 / 2, 32, 10 |

- Isolation: I ran `--sequence.shuffle` with seeds 1, 7, 42 and 1234. Seed 42 runs the order "every hole", "get_record", "0 when"; seed 1234 runs "0 when", "every hole", "get_record". All 3 cases passed in every order. I also ran each case alone with `-t`: 1 passed and 2 skipped, every time.
- Reverse check: I removed the `beforeEach` reset. Seed 1234 then fails "every hole", because the rows "0 when" inserted are still in the table when it asserts `toHaveLength(1)`. The other three orders still pass, because "every hole" runs before "0 when" in them. So the reset is what keeps the cases independent.
- The whole example suite, 5 runs in a row on `c497cf52`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo exec vitest run`, each exit 0 with `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 249 passed (249)`.

## Acceptance notes

- The boot budget is per file (`beforeAll`, 30 s), not per case. The cases now run without a boot and take at most 49 ms locally, even under load, so they keep vitest's default timeout.
- Other sibling files in `examples/app-todo/test` still boot a kernel in each case: `task-recurrence.test.ts` (slowest case 2099 ms in job 128575054246, 2060 ms earlier), `task-completion-trigger.test.ts` (GATES 1447 ms, 1763 ms earlier) and `derived-flag-removal.test.ts` (1128 ms). None of them is at the 5 s line, so they are not changed here. If one is ever cut off, the same shape applies.

## Verification

All on `c497cf52` (this branch after #31312 merged, with `origin/main` merged in, no rebase):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 37 commands. Every one ran with exit 0, after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='./packages/**' --concurrency=2` so the gates that read built output measured. `--ran`: "37 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo typecheck`: exit 0.
- Not run locally: `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project), because this diff does not touch it. Test Core runs it on this PR.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Test-only in a private example package; nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
